story_clusters.summary: Multiple high courts in India have set aside GST orders due to procedural violations, including the denial of hearings and communication beyond statutory timelines. The Orissa High Court quashed a ₹28.81 crore GST order for being communicated beyond the seven-day limit under Section 129(3), while the Telangana High Court set aside a GST show-cause notice (SCN) and order for violating the Section 73(2) timeline. Additionally, RBL Bank received a ₹104 crore GST notice but claims earlier rulings support its case.

This distinction is crucial for ensuring fairness in criminal proceedings and property rights.
